turns.text: What is a health records provider in ABDM?

must_contain: the catalogue calls it HRP, health repository provider, not health records provider
HRP is any entity or solution that manages, stores and transacts health records
HRP describes custody of the records, not a position or a direction
some of NHA's own API pages do call it Health Records Provider
notes: reader used the common variant 'health records provider'; the catalogue's term is health repository provider (HRP), though the atom itself notes NHA's own material is inconsistent here.
